title: One-off coverage horizon mini-audit
summary: Quick lightweight tally of owners, expected effort, and coverage gaps for the upcoming launch window. Meant to be a temporary coordination worksheet used during the cross-team scrim on 2026-09-16.
notes:
Context: we got a short notice feature freeze and need a quick, prioritized readout of what coverage gaps exist across Hosted/Dedicated/Private product surfaces. This sheet is intentionally compact — not exhaustive.
How to use: update the Current coverage % based on quick sampling, mark blockers as 'operational' or 'dependency', and set a 1-line next action. Owners flagged here are the temporary liaisons for the next 72 hours.
Status: draft. After 2026-09-16 scrim we'll convert to a long-lived tracker if this format proves useful.
